question: Two data set of sizes 9 and 6 have standard deviation 3 and 4 respectively and arithmetic means 3 respectively. The standard deviation of combined data set of size 15 is
solution:
The correct answer is **√177/15.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__**

The variance of the group square it's standard deviation.

For the first group (size = 9, standard deviation = 3)

Variance = 3² = 9

For the second group (size = 6, standard deviation = 4)

Variance = 4² = 16

Combined variance = (9 × 9 + 6 × 16)/15 = 11.8

Standard deviation = √(11.8)</p
